title: Bharat Ka Pehla Rocket Cycle Par! 🚀 Aaj Hi Ke Din, 1963 | ISRO #shorts
description:
Bharat ka pehla rocket cycle par laaya gaya tha! 🚀🇮🇳 Aaj hi ke din, 21 November 1963 ko Thumba (Kerala) se uda tha.
ISRO ki shuruaat ki kahani 5 facts mein.

21 Nov 1963, shaam 6:25 – Thumba se launch • Nike-Apache rocket ke hisse cycle aur bailgaadi par pahunche • Church bana control room, Bishop ka ghar bana office • 715 kg ka rocket 207 km upar gaya, aasmaan mein naarangi baadal • Vikram Sarabhai aur APJ Abdul Kalam the wahaan

ISRO ka aapka favourite mission kaunsa hai – Chandrayaan ya Mangalyaan? Comment karo! 👇
